countdown.title: DIRECTED BY THE LORD // GENESIS DROP
countdown.subtitle: Worldwide Release & Archival Silhouette Premiere
countdown.description: Archival heavyweight 500 GSM Portuguese terry, thick raised 3D puff print, dense chain embroidery, genuine crystal rhinestones, and hand-distressed vintage washes. Zero polyester. Directed by the Lord. January 1, 2027.

images.title: Streetwear & Sneaker Reselling Vault
images.caption: Authentic clothes & shoes inventory: Alo Yoga grey sweatpants, baby pink Lululemon top, Bape graphic tee, Awful Lot of Cough Syrup Scarface tee, and limited hype sneakers on chrome liquid puddle rug.

images.title: Anime Sketchbook Character Studies
images.caption: Hand-drawn sketchbook artwork: Sukuna / Yuji Itadori (虎杖 悠仁), Light Yagami with Death Note (夜神 月), and Obito Uchiha with Sharingan and Rinnegan (うちは オビト).

images.title: Elsen Keena
images.caption: Grossmont High School student, creator, and founder of the Lord Knows streetwear brand.

images.title: DIRECTED BY THE LORD Heavyweight Hoodie
images.caption: Back: Thick 3D raised matte puff print 'DIRECTED BY THE LORD' in sharp barbed-wire frame. Front: 'STAY HUMBLE - LORD KNOWS'. 100% 500 GSM loopback cotton, zero polyester.

images.title: Gothic Triple Cross Vintage Mineral Wash Tee
images.caption: Front: Arched 3D puff gothic 'LORD KNOWS'. Back: Three staggered gothic crosses with cursive 'LK' in tactile raised puff print. 300 GSM dense combed cotton.

images.title: Crown of Thorns 'God Before All' Vintage Tee
images.caption: Ash grey 300 GSM dry-hand cotton. Front: Raised 3D puff 'LORD KNOWS'. Back: Crown of Thorns graphic with heavy 3D puff 'GOD BEFORE ALL'.

images.title: Iced Out Gothic Cross Heather Grey Zip Hoodie
images.caption: 100% cotton 500 GSM loopback fleece with custom silver YKK zipper. Clear diamond crystal rhinestones form cursive 'LK' on left chest and an ornate gothic cross on the back.

images.title: Sapphire Crystal Cross Washed Black Zip Hoodie
images.caption: Washed black 500 GSM French terry cotton. Royal sapphire blue crystal rhinestones & 3D puff embroidery cursive 'LK' on chest and back gothic cross.

images.title: Sapphire Rhinestone Flared Wide-Leg Sweatpants
images.caption: 100% 480 GSM cotton fleece flared pants with thick white cotton rope drawstrings. Royal sapphire blue rhinestone script down both outer flared legs.

images.title: Stardust Rhinestone Raw-Hem Fleece Shorts
images.caption: Raw frayed hem 100% heavy cotton fleece shorts. Thick white rope drawstrings with metal aglets, scattered crystal stardust, and raised 3D puff gothic cursive 'Lord Knows'.

images.title: Heavy Duck Canvas Riveted Carpenter Trousers
images.caption: Rigid 14oz 100% cotton duck canvas work pants. Silver metal rivets reinforcing deep square rear utility pockets, hammer loop, and tonal cursive 'LK' hip embroidery.

images.title: Bouclé Wool 'Lord Knows' Heavy Knit Sweater
images.caption: Chunky heavyweight wool-cotton blend crewneck. 3D tactile bouclé chain-stitch cursive 'Lord Knows' across chest. Extra-thick ribbed collar and cuffs.

images.title: Directed By The Lord Showroom Archive
images.caption: Editorial flat-lay lookbook still life of the core 2027 collection pieces on brutalist dark slate slabs. Real heavyweight cotton, 3D puff ink, and crystal stones.

products.name: DIRECTED BY THE LORD Heavyweight Hoodie
products.description: 100% dense 500 GSM Portuguese French terry cotton. Back features heavy 3D raised matte puff print 'DIRECTED BY THE LORD' in a sharp barbed-wire frame; front features 'STAY HUMBLE - LORD KNOWS'. Ribbed hems, drop-shoulder cut, zero polyester.

products.name: Iced Out Gothic Cross Zip Hoodie
products.description: 500 GSM loopback cotton fleece with custom silver YKK zipper. Glistening clear diamond crystal rhinestones form cursive 'LK' on left chest and an ornate gothic cross on the back.

products.name: Sapphire Crystal Cross Zip Hoodie
products.description: Deep royal sapphire blue crystal rhinestones and 3D puff embroidery on pitch-washed 500 GSM French terry. Left chest cursive 'LK' and large back gothic cross.

products.name: Gothic Triple Cross Mineral Wash Tee
products.description: 300 GSM dense combed cotton with authentic mineral stone wash. Front arched 3D puff gothic 'LORD KNOWS' calligraphy, back triple gothic crosses († † †) with cursive 'LK'.

products.name: Crown of Thorns 'God Before All' Tee
products.description: Heavy 300 GSM dry-hand cotton jersey. 3D puff 'LORD KNOWS' on front chest. Back displays circular Crown of Thorns graphic with thick raised puff 'GOD BEFORE ALL' lettering.

products.name: Sapphire Rhinestone Flared Sweatpants
products.description: Heavyweight 480 GSM cotton fleece with flared wide-leg cut. Chunky white cotton rope drawstrings with raw knotted ends and vivid sapphire blue rhinestone cursive: 'Lord' down one leg, 'Knows' down the other.

products.name: Stardust Rhinestone Raw-Hem Shorts
products.description: Raw frayed hem 450 GSM cotton fleece shorts. Thick white rope drawstrings with metal aglets, scattered crystal rhinestone stardust, and raised 3D puff gothic cursive 'Lord Knows' on the right thigh.

products.name: Duck Canvas Riveted Carpenter Trousers
products.description: Heavyweight structured 14oz 100% cotton duck canvas work pants. Silver metal rivets reinforcing deep square rear utility pockets, hammer loop, double-knee panels, and tonal cursive 'LK' embroidery.

products.name: Bouclé Wool 'Lord Knows' Knit Sweater
products.description: Chunky wool-cotton oversized crewneck. 3D tactile bouclé cursive chain-stitch 'Lord Knows' across chest. Extra-thick ribbed collar and hem.
